author: (Linnaeus, 1758)
evidence: iNaturalist: observations along the coast and lagoons (several hundred, mixed quality)

about.en: The little blue heron is a medium, slate-blue heron that wades slowly through shallow water, lagoon edges and mangroves looking for small fish and crabs. Young birds are white, which is why it is confused with the snowy egret. It is a regular sight along this coast. It is protected. Look for it in quiet shallows and mangrove channels.
about.es: La garceta azul es una garza mediana, gris azulada, que vadea despacio por aguas someras, orillas de lagunas y manglares buscando peces pequeños y cangrejos. Los jóvenes son blancos, por lo que se confunden con la garceta nívea. Es una vista regular en esta costa. Está protegida. Búsquela en bajos tranquilos y canales de manglar.

idTips.en: Adult: slate blue with a purplish head and neck, grey bill with a dark tip, dull green legs. Young: white with greyish-green legs and a dark-tipped bill; patchy blue as they moult.
idTips.es: Adulto: gris azulado con cabeza y cuello púrpura, pico gris con la punta oscura, patas verde apagado. Joven: blanco con patas verde grisáceo y pico de punta oscura; moteado de azul al mudar.

tip.en: Snowy egret has a black bill and yellow feet; young little blue herons have a grey bill and green legs.
tip.es: La garceta nívea tiene el pico negro y los pies amarillos; los jóvenes de garceta azul tienen el pico gris y las patas verdes.

text.en: Juvenile: white with a grey bill and greenish legs.
text.es: Juvenil: blanco con pico gris y patas verdosas.

diet.en: Small fish, crabs, shrimp, frogs and insects.
diet.es: Peces pequeños, cangrejos, camarones, ranas e insectos.

predators.en: Few as adults; eggs and chicks are taken by snakes and mammals.
predators.es: Pocos de adultos; los huevos y polluelos los comen serpientes y mamíferos.

behaviour.en: Walks slowly and stabs. Feeds alone, nests and roosts in groups in mangroves and trees.
behaviour.es: Camina despacio y picotea. Se alimenta solo, anida y descansa en grupos en manglares y árboles.

where.en: Lagoon edges, mangrove channels, estuaries and wet fields near the coast.
where.es: Orillas de lagunas, canales de manglar, estuarios y campos húmedos cerca de la costa.

edibleNote.en: No food use is documented for this species here. wild birds are covered by the wildlife law[^3], which bans taking species declared threatened; no hunting permit for them was found, and many fish-eaters taste strongly of fish. Not worth taking.
edibleNote.es: No se documenta uso como alimento de esta especie aquí. Las aves silvestres están cubiertas por la ley de vida silvestre[^3], que prohíbe tomar especies declaradas amenazadas; no se encontró permiso de caza para ellas, y muchas que comen pescado saben fuerte a pescado. No vale la pena.

edibleScope: No food use documented here; protected wildlife in Costa Rica
recWhy: Common along coast and lagoons[^4] but no named site in the stretch.

marks.en: Slate-blue heron with a purple-maroon head and neck as an adult; juveniles all white with greenish legs.
marks.es: Garza azul pizarra con cabeza y cuello púrpura rojizo en adultos; los jóvenes son totalmente blancos con patas verdosas.
